 Coachella 2027 brings together pop, R&B, alternative music and electronic sounds. Here is all about Coachella 2027 dates, how to buy tickets, prices, and where to watch online. The Coachella 2027 lineup includes Diljit Dosanjh, Dua Lipa, SZA, Tame Impala and others. Coachella 2027 returns to California's Empire Polo Club with headliners Dua Lipa, SZA and Tame Impala, alongside Indian singer Diljit Dosanjh and several international performers. Here's a look at the Coachella 2027 performers, April festival dates, ticket prices and how to watch the event online.  Indian singer and actor Diljit Dosanjh is heading back to one of the world's biggest music festivals. The Coachella 2027 lineup is out, and the Punjabi singer is sharing the bill with Dua Lipa, SZA and Tame Impala, who will headline the three-day festival. Madonna, Zara Larsson, Jisoo, Peggy Gou, Steve Lacy and Phoebe Bridgers are also among the artists set to perform. Here is everything you need to know about Coachella 2027 dates, how to buy tickets, prices, and where to watch online. Coachella returns to the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, across two weekends, April 9-11 and April 16-18, with tickets going on general sale on November 13. So, there's plenty to look forward to across both weekends.
 Dosanjh's return is a notable moment for Indian music, particularly after his 2023 Coachella debut brought Punjabi music to the international festival stage. This time, he joins a lineup that moves between Dua Lipa's pop, SZA's R&B and Tame Impala's psychedelic sound, with Madonna adding another major name to the bill. 
 Coachella 2027 Lineup: Who's Headlining
 Dua Lipa, SZA and Tame Impala hold the headline slots, and each brings a different kind of night: Dua Lipa's arena-scale pop, SZA's smoky R&B, and the shimmering psychedelic haze of Australia's Tame Impala. Diljit Dosanjh , the Punjabi superstar, returns to the bill too.
 After them, the bill is still generous. Madonna, Zara Larsson, Jisoo, Peggy Gou, Steve Lacy, Daddy Yankee, Phoebe Bridgers, Robyn and Don Toliver all appear, while dance-floor devotees get Tiësto, Martin Garrix, Dom Dolla and Kygo.

 Coachella will return to the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, for two consecutive weekends in April 2027.
 Weekend 1: April 9 to 11, 2027
 Weekend 2: April 16 to 18, 2027
 Both weekends will feature the same lineup, art installations, food and activities. This gives festivalgoers the flexibility to choose their preferred dates without missing out on the main performances.
 How to Buy Coachella 2027 Tickets
 Passes for Coachella 2027 will go on sale on Friday, November 13, at 12 pm Pacific Time. For buyers in India, that translates to 1:30 am IST on Saturday, November 14. Tickets can be purchased through the festival's official website.
 The official website currently lists Tier 2 General Admission passes with a three-day shuttle for US$779 for either weekend. Tier 2 VIP passes are listed at US$1,399. Standard General Admission passes are marked as sold out on the current page. Prices and availability are subject to change.
 How to Watch Coachella 2027 Online
 Travelling to California is not the only way to experience the festival. YouTube will return as Coachella's exclusive livestream partner, allowing viewers to watch performances from both weekends. The festival's livestream app will also offer performance replays, schedules and personalised viewing options.
